entries.evidence: The preserved authoritative 20 measured-step summary from sequential ON-first job 2373273 reports PolicyTraining throughput 5270.9812 versus 4902.8530 tokens/s/GPU (+7.5084%), E2E throughput +2.49%, and median step-time speedup +2.90% for CuTeDSL ON versus OFF.
entries.limitation: This is an interim single-job result from the pre-isolation source cohort. Simultaneous Logprob and Refit movement indicates a temporal confound, and no opposite-order fixed-source replicas have been accepted; it is not claim-ready. Qwen3-235B functional job 2375783 remains pending and has no runtime evidence.
entries.next_gate: Preserve the completed artifacts, then rerun all fixed-source ON/OFF cells with alternating order and report matched post-warmup component timings.

entries.evidence: Job 2373274 failed immutable preflight after concurrent node-local-rank-zero Bridge initialization found no locked python3-config, built a suffixless helpers_cpp in shared editable MCore, and dirtied the checkout. The local fix through 4cb3ea20c uses a tracked-only run overlay, matching ABI tool, serialized helper build, UV_NO_EDITABLE, Pyxis-safe environment prefixes, and command-hash refresh.
entries.limitation: Local harness and wrapper checks pass, but no accepted Linux/Pyxis aarch64 functional or concurrent-job validation has completed. The old held cohort must not be released or mixed with the fixed source.
entries.next_gate: Complete isolated helper functional and two-job concurrency gates, quarantine only the bounded old artifacts, and submit a new immutable-source cohort.

entries.evidence: Jobs 2369539 and 2369580 completed three eager warmups, then both failed at update 4's first capture because the variable-size alltoall dispatcher called d2h_event.synchronize inside capture. The corrected local recipe now follows the flex/HybridEP static-budget and PagedStash dependency bundle.
entries.limitation: Jobs 2369539 and 2369580 used the invalid alltoall, capacity-null, PagedStash-disabled bundle. Corrected jobs 2375779 and 2375780 then failed before runtime because a separate unit-test job temporarily wrote untracked unit_results into their shared source worktree. None produced valid Full-CG timing; no speedup is reported.
entries.next_gate: Run the corrected noncolocated HybridEP functional cell and require capture_calls == 1, replay_calls >= 2, monotonic counters, stable storage digest, and no overflow-retry correctness failure before matched timing.

entries.evidence: Job 2369580 enabled overlap_moe_expert_parallel_comm, the high-priority A2A stream, and delayed WGRAD. It still failed at the same first-capture D2H synchronization as A2A-OFF job 2369539, proving A2A does not remove the variable-size dispatcher host sync.
entries.limitation: The earlier comparison stopped at capture failure and has no accepted timing window. Corrected Q30 job 2375780 failed dirty-source preflight. Qwen3-235B VPP+A2A job 2375785 was cancelled while pending after PR #1126 review found that its inherited defer_fp32_logits=true is rejected by the combined A2A schedule. A2A performance remains unmeasured; no speedup is reported.
entries.next_gate: Use source eff1d64af with defer_fp32_logits=false in both A2A OFF/ON cells, then verify NCCL A2A presence and temporal overlap before reporting an effect.

entries.evidence: The teammate implementation in NeMo-RL PR #1126 was manually ported onto current main: setup preserves all virtual model chunks, the interleaved schedule receives one iterator per chunk, reference/refit/checkpoint state is chunk-qualified, and Qwen3-235B has a strict PP4/VPP2 profile. Source eff1d64af also adds a non-VPP performance baseline with the same 22/24 layer partition and selective recompute settings.
entries.limitation: Dependency-free contract probes and 132 focused local tests pass. Fresh-image locked-mcore smokes 2376166 on Ptyche and 2370500 on Lyris both passed on four GB200 GPUs with TE 2.15, MCore, Bridge, ModelOpt, and a real TE Linear backward. This proves both runtimes, not VPP training correctness. Qwen3-235B VPP job 2375784 remains pending but is not a valid VPP-only comparison against 2375783 because their recompute and layer partition differ. Job 2375785 was cancelled. No GB200 VPP PolicyTraining/Logprob/refit run has passed yet, and the port deliberately rejects VPP with Full-CG until upstream supports the combination.
entries.next_gate: Run the focused PR #1126 functional tests in the verified locked runtime, then compare the new matched non-VPP profile against VPP2 before running VPP2+A2A.
